entry.title: Quantum Compute Consortium Publishes Open Calibration Standard
entry.summary: Research laboratories across three continents agreed on a unified error-budget benchmark for superconducting qubit architectures. The consensus standard will be maintained by an open foundation.

entry.title: Next-Generation Optical Interconnects Pass Subsea Deployment Trials
entry.summary: Telecommunication consortiums reported sustained terabit-per-second throughput across transatlantic hollow-core fiber cables. Commercial activation is scheduled for the second quarter.
